name: io.github.0xsims/rubric-mcp
description: AI compliance attestation for EU AI Act, SR 11-7, HIPAA. Free local tier, no key required.

environmentVariables.name: RUBRIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Rubric API key for Hedera mainnet anchoring. Optional — omit for free local PQ-signed attestation.

environmentVariables.name: RUBRIC_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a dedicated low-balance wallet used to pay for x402 tools in USDC on Base. The key is stored in plaintext in the client config. Do not auto-approve the paid tools.

environmentVariables.name: RUBRIC_X402_DAILY_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Per-process daily USDC spend ceiling for x402 tools, as a decimal such as 0.25. Empty or invalid values use the default of 0.25. Each process applies its own limit to the shared ~/.rubric/x402-spend.json ledger.
